answer: Trace where each agent's starting funds came from and pool agents by that source: every account whose first deposit flows down the same river of wallets shares one reward pot, paid out by the square root of its size. Splitting into a plume of fresh accounts then earns almost nothing extra, since 100 fakes fed from one treasury get 10 shares, not 100. The tale of a thousand independent agents becomes a fable unless the attacker buys clean, unlinked funds for each one, often through costly OTC deals.
